questions.q: The Supreme Court has recognized the right to walk on safe footpaths as a fundamental right under which article?
questions.explain:
The court has considered it a fundamental right under Article 19(1)(d) and Article 21.

The decision was given by a bench of Justice P. S. Narasimha and Justice A. S. Chandurkar.

questions.q: Rakhigarhi archaeological site, recently seen in news, is located in which state?
questions.explain:
Rakhigarhi, located in Hisar District of Haryana

The most important civilization of the Indus-Saraswati (Harappan) Civilization

It is considered to be the largest known archaeological site.

During the excavation of 2025-26, 8 graves were found here, in which 3 complete human skeletons were found.

These remains have been handed over to the Anthropological Survey of India for further investigation.

questions.q: The first batch of pilgrims for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra 2026 recently entered China through which pass?
questions.explain:
First batch of pilgrims of Kailash Mansarovar Yatra in Sikkim Entered China via Nathu La Pass.

Sikkim Governor, Om Prakash Mathur, welcomed the first batch.

This first batch includes 44 pilgrims from different states of India.

This annual yatra is organised every year between June and September.

There are two main routes for this journey – first Nathu La Pass (Sikkim) and second Lipulekh Pass (Uttarakhand).
